identityHelp: A unique identifier for your account on this server. You can use whatever you like, such as an email address or a username. This won't be shared publicly.
insecureDesc: You are accessing the server over an insecure connection (HTTP). Your login, messages, and file transfers may not be protected in transit. If you administer this server, set up HTTPS by following the documentation.
registrationDisabled: New user registrations are currently disabled. If you do not have an account yet, you need to be invited by an existing user to join this server.
invitedTitle: You were invited to join this server
